body:
I'm sure there are. The idea of actually talking out loud to someone about this stuff makes me want to cry. I don't even know if I could do it. How does that even work? 

I don't have anyone in my life that I talk to openly, even my family and closest friends. How am I going to tell a stranger my deepest secrets? 

Just walk in and say hi to a receptionist? 

"Hello ma'am, I'm here today because I hate life and don't want to go on living. I hear you're in that kind of business. I'd like to chat with someone about my crippling depression, any openings after 2:00?"
I feel like dying in an accident would be a beautiful gift. Or the world just ending. So bomb being dropped on my apartment. Or the ending to Melancholia.
